rationale: Re-implementing placeBIP() so gabaMOD is spatially gated by per-synapse locx is a fix to the deposited Poleg-Polsky 2016 code. The brainstorm session 9 decision is to step away from modifying deposited code and build the equivalent mechanism into a from-scratch minimal DSGC instead (t0053 implements spatial PD/ND-asymmetric inhibition natively). Keep at medium priority because it remains a valid drop-in fix if the deposited lineage is ever revived.
